items.summary: TechNode reports that tensions rose in Silicon Valley after Chinese AI firm DeepSeek launched its R1 model, which the outlet says outperformed top US AI companies while undercutting their costs.

items.title_zh: 字节跳动董事会成员称 TikTok 交易接近完成，预计周末前有方案
items.summary: ByteDance board member and General Atlantic CEO Bill Ford said the company is actively discussing a TikTok deal to prevent the app from being banned, with a solution expected by the weekend, TechNode reported.

items.summary: Moonshot AI's Kimi K1.5 GitHub repository covers work on scaling reinforcement learning with large language models.

items.title: FireRedTeam/FireRedASR
items.raw_content: Open-source industrial-grade ASR models supporting Mandarin, Chinese dialects and English, achieving a new SOTA on public Mandarin ASR benchmarks, while also offering outstanding singing lyrics recognition capability.  [Lang: Python]
items.title_zh: FireRedTeam/FireRedASR：开源工业级语音识别模型
items.summary: FireRedASR is a set of open-source, industrial-grade ASR models supporting Mandarin, Chinese dialects, and English. The project reports a new state of the art on public Mandarin ASR benchmarks and strong singing-lyrics recognition.

items.title: Ask HN: Is anyone making money selling traditional downloadable software?
items.title_zh: Ask HN：还有人靠销售传统可下载软件赚钱吗？
items.summary: A Hacker News user asks whether anyone is running a successful business selling desktop or downloadable software under a one-time payment model rather than SaaS or subscriptions, and what support and updates are like.

items.title: Official DeepSeek R1 Now on Ollama
items.title_zh: DeepSeek R1 正式上线 Ollama
items.summary: DeepSeek-R1, a family of open reasoning models, is now available on Ollama; the project says its performance approaches leading models such as O3 and Gemini 2.5 Pro.

items.title: Concept cells help your brain abstract information and build memories
items.title_zh: 概念细胞帮助大脑抽象信息并构建记忆
items.summary: Quanta Magazine reports that individual concept neurons, once known as 'Jennifer Aniston cells,' light up for specific ideas and support thinking, imagination and recall of life episodes.

items.title: Show HN: Printercow – Turn any thermal printer into an API endpoint
items.title_zh: Show HN：Printercow——把任何热敏打印机变成 API 端点
items.summary: Printercow turns ESC/POS-compatible thermal printers into HTTP endpoints with one command, adding automatic image dithering, scaling and failover protection; new users receive 300 free prints.

items.title: Open Heart Protocol
items.title_zh: Open Heart 协议
items.summary: The Open Heart protocol lets an anonymous user send an emoji reaction to a URL, with an endpoint receiving the reaction as a POST request.

items.title: What are these bumps on the top of a pull-tab can?
items.title_zh: 易拉罐拉环顶部的这些凸起是什么？
items.summary: A Reddit thread asks about the purpose of the small bumps found on the top of pull-tab beverage cans.

items.title: Operator research preview
items.title_zh: Operator 研究预览
items.summary: OpenAI has announced a research preview of Operator, according to the linked OpenAI announcement.

items.title: Working with Files Is Hard (2019)
items.title_zh: 处理文件很难（2019）
items.summary: A pseudo-transcript of a 2019 talk argues that files are far more complicated than many developers assume, touching on topics such as filesystem support and Dropbox's ext4 decision.

items.title: Little Snitch feature nobody knows about
items.title_zh: Little Snitch 一个鲜为人知的功能
items.summary: Using Little Snitch, the author found that Safari's Search Helper process contacts ssl.gstatic.com, a Google-owned domain, on every launch even when Safari opens a private window with a blank page.

items.title: An invalid 68030 instruction accidentally allowed the Mac Classic II to boot
items.title_zh: 一条无效的 68030 指令意外让 Mac Classic II 成功启动
items.summary: A deep dive into an Apple ROM bug in the Macintosh Classic II that should have stopped the machine from booting, until its Motorola MC68030 CPU executed an undefined instruction that accidentally avoided a crash. The author found the behavior while working with the MAME emulator.

items.title: OpenRA – Classic strategy games rebuilt for the modern era
items.title_zh: OpenRA：为现代环境重制的经典即时战略游戏
items.summary: OpenRA is an open-source project that recreates and modernizes classic real-time strategy games such as Red Alert, Command & Conquer and Dune 2000.

items.title: You could have invented Fenwick trees
items.title_zh: 你本可以发明 Fenwick 树
items.summary: A Cambridge University Press paper explains Fenwick trees, also known as binary indexed trees, by starting from segment trees and using equational reasoning to derive the bitwise implementation as an optimized variant, with a Haskell EDSL for infinite two's complement binary numbers.

items.title: No one is disrupting banks – at least not the big ones
items.title_zh: 没有人正在颠覆银行——至少不是那些大银行
items.summary: After the largest U.S. banks reported fourth-quarter and full-year 2024 results, the author argues that nearly 30 years of fintech has not disrupted the big banks' core model of taking deposits and issuing loans.

items.title: YC Graveyard: 821 inactive Y Combinator startups
items.title_zh: YC 墓地：821 家已停止运营的 Y Combinator 初创公司
items.summary: A website called YC Graveyard catalogues 821 inactive startups from Y Combinator.

items.title: Silicon Valley stunned as China’s DeepSeek-R1 surpasses US AI giants, undercuts costs
items.title_zh: 硅谷震惊：中国 DeepSeek-R1 超越美国 AI 巨头并压低成本
items.summary: TechNode reports that tensions rose in Silicon Valley after Chinese AI firm DeepSeek launched its R1 model, which the outlet says outperformed top US AI companies while undercutting their costs.

items.title: ByteDance board member says TikTok deal nears completion, solution expected by weekend
items.title_zh: 字节跳动董事会成员称 TikTok 交易接近完成，预计周末前有方案
items.summary: ByteDance board member and General Atlantic CEO Bill Ford said the company is actively discussing a TikTok deal to prevent the app from being banned, with a solution expected by the weekend, TechNode reported.

items.title: CATL strikes deal for world’s first 24/7 renewable project in UAE
items.title_zh: 宁德时代签约阿联酋全球首个全天候可再生能源项目
items.summary: Masdar, the UAE's clean energy company, selected CATL to supply battery energy storage systems for a project described as the world's first 24/7 renewable energy initiative, TechNode reports.

items.title: US fines Genshin Impact game developer miHoYo $20m for alleged deceptive marketing and child privacy violations
items.title_zh: 美国因涉嫌欺骗性营销和儿童隐私违规对《原神》开发商米哈游处以 2000 万美元罚款
items.summary: miHoYo's U.S. subsidiary Cognosphere agreed to pay $20 million to settle allegations that Genshin Impact's gacha system used deceptive marketing and that the company violated child privacy laws.

items.title: TikTok bounces back after ban, is it here to stay?
items.title_zh: TikTok 在禁令后恢复，能否就此留下？
items.summary: TikTok became accessible to users again on the second day after the ban and the day before the new president's inauguration, according to TechNode.

items.title: NIO becomes latest Chinese automaker to enter robotics
items.title_zh: 蔚来成为最新一家进军机器人领域的中国车企
items.summary: NIO is the latest Chinese automaker to enter robotics, a market the report says has already attracted BYD, Chery and GAC.

items.title: CATL to report record profit in 2024 despite revenue decline amid lithium price slump
items.title_zh: 宁德时代 2024 年利润将创新高，但锂价低迷拖累营收下滑
items.summary: CATL warned it might end 2024 with its first revenue decline since it began publishing financial figures in 2015, even as it expects to report record profit, according to TechNode.

items.title: WeChat tests new call answering feature on iOS, ditches CallKit for LiveCommunicationKit
items.title_zh: 微信在 iOS 测试新的通话接听功能，以 LiveCommunicationKit 取代 CallKit
items.summary: WeChat has begun large-scale testing of a new call-receiving feature for voice and video calls on iOS after releasing version 8.0.55, moving from CallKit to LiveCommunicationKit.

items.title: Xiaomi SU7 outsells Tesla Model 3 in China in December
items.title_zh: 小米 SU7 去年 12 月在华销量超越特斯拉 Model 3
items.summary: Xiaomi's SU7 all-electric sedan outsold Tesla's Model 3 in China for the first time in December, according to TechNode.

items.title: Xiaomi CEO Lei Jun’s live stream suspended on Douyin for streaming while driving
items.title_zh: 小米 CEO 雷军因边开车边直播，抖音直播被暂停
items.summary: Xiaomi CEO Lei Jun's live stream on Douyin was suspended for streaming while driving, according to a TechNode report.

items.title: FireRedTeam/FireRedASR
items.title_zh: FireRedTeam/FireRedASR：开源工业级语音识别模型
items.summary: FireRedASR is a set of open-source, industrial-grade ASR models supporting Mandarin, Chinese dialects, and English. The project reports a new state of the art on public Mandarin ASR benchmarks and strong singing-lyrics recognition.

items.title: GoogleCloudPlatform/kubectl-ai
items.title_zh: GoogleCloudPlatform/kubectl-ai：AI 驱动的 Kubernetes 助手
items.summary: An AI-powered Kubernetes assistant from Google Cloud Platform, written in Go.

items.title: Tencent-Hunyuan/Hunyuan3D-2
items.title_zh: Tencent-Hunyuan/Hunyuan3D-2：高分辨率 3D 资产生成
items.summary: The Hunyuan3D-2 Python repository is built around Tencent's large-scale diffusion models for producing high-resolution 3D assets.

items.title: documentdb/documentdb
items.title_zh: documentdb/documentdb：兼容 MongoDB 的数据库引擎
items.summary: DocumentDB is a MongoDB-compatible database engine written in C and aimed at cloud-native and open-source workloads, with a focus on scalability and performance.

items.title: multimodal-art-projection/YuE
items.title_zh: multimodal-art-projection/YuE：前沿音乐生成模型
items.summary: YuE2 is a Python project for frontier music generation, featuring symbolic planning, zero-shot covers and agentic music editing.

items.title: usertour/usertour
items.title_zh: usertour/usertour：开源用户引导平台
items.summary: Usertour is an open-source user onboarding platform for building in-app product tours, checklists, and surveys, positioned as an alternative to Userflow and Appcues.

items.title: zarfadev/Navicat_Patch_v18
items.title_zh: Navicat_Patch_v18：解锁 Navicat Premium 18 高级功能
items.summary: A repository offering a patch and guide intended to unlock all premium features of Navicat Premium v18.

items.title: winfunc/deepreasoning
items.title_zh: DeepReasoning：融合 DeepSeek R1 思维链与 Claude 的推理界面
items.summary: DeepReasoning is a Rust-based high-performance LLM inference API and chat UI that combines DeepSeek R1's chain-of-thought reasoning traces with Anthropic Claude models.

items.title: scottbez1/FaderBuddy
items.title_zh: FaderBuddy：即插即用的电动推子
items.summary: FaderBuddy provides plug-and-play motorized faders for ESPHome and other setups, implemented in C++.

items.title: Characterization of GPU TEE Overheads in Distributed Data Parallel ML Training
items.title_zh: 分布式数据并行 ML 训练中 GPU TEE 的开销分析
items.summary: The authors characterize performance overhead when distributed data-parallel training runs inside NVIDIA GPU trusted execution environments, finding that iteration time rose by an average of 8x and up to 41.6x with four GPU TEEs.

items.title: Advancing the Understanding and Evaluation of AR-Generated Scenes: When Vision-Language Models Shine and Stumble
items.title_zh: 推进对 AR 生成场景的理解与评估：视觉语言模型何时出彩、何时失误
items.summary: Apple researchers evaluated GPT, Gemini and Claude on AR scene understanding with the DiverseAR dataset, finding true positive rates of up to 93% for perception and 71% for description, with weaker results on seamlessly integrated virtual objects.

items.title: Personalizing Education through an Adaptive LMS with Integrated LLMs
items.title_zh: 通过集成 LLM 的自适应学习管理系统实现个性化教育
items.summary: The paper explores integrating general-purpose and domain-specific LLMs into learning management systems to build an adaptive system that personalizes content for learners at different educational stages. It aims to address privacy concerns and reduce factual inaccuracies and outdated information common in general LLMs such as ChatGPT.

items.title: A Review Paper of the Effects of Distinct Modalities and ML Techniques to Distracted Driving Detection
items.title_zh: 不同模态与机器学习技术在分心驾驶检测中的效果综述
items.summary: A systematic review analyzes machine learning and deep learning methods for distracted driving detection across visual, sensory, auditory and multimodal data, and assesses which approaches suit specific detection goals.

items.title: How Does the Spatial Distribution of Pre-training Data Affect Geospatial Foundation Models?
items.title_zh: 预训练数据的空间分布如何影响地理空间基础模型？
items.summary: The study samples different geographic compositions of pre-training data for two geospatial foundation models and finds that balanced, globally representative data often outperforms region-specific sampling on downstream tasks.

items.title: Autonomous Structural Memory Manipulation for Large Language Models Using Hierarchical Embedding Augmentation
items.title_zh: 利用分层嵌入增强实现大语言模型的自主结构化记忆操作
items.summary: The paper proposes hierarchical embedding augmentation and autonomous structural memory manipulation that dynamically reallocates memory to prioritize relevant context, reporting efficiency gains on longer inputs and improved accuracy and interpretability against baselines.

items.title: A Post-Processing-Based Fair Federated Learning Framework
items.title_zh: 基于后处理的公平联邦学习框架
items.summary: The paper defines and evaluates a two-stage framework for group fairness in federated learning: standard training such as FedAvg followed by fully decentralized local debiasing. Tests on four tabular, signal and image datasets show fairness gains with little or no accuracy loss, especially under heterogeneous data.

items.title: Transformer-Based Multimodal Knowledge Graph Completion with Link-Aware Contexts
items.title_zh: 基于 Transformer 与链接感知上下文的多模态知识图谱补全
items.summary: The paper combines Transformer-based knowledge graph embedding with cross-modal context generated by a pre-trained vision-language model, turning visual information from entities and their neighbors into text sequences. It frames knowledge graph completion as sequence-to-sequence and reports competitive results with a much smaller model than traditional approaches.

items.title: Benchmarking LLMs' Mathematical Reasoning with Unseen Random Variables Questions
items.title_zh: 用未见随机变量问题评测 LLM 的数学推理能力
items.summary: The authors propose RV-Bench, which generates randomized versions of math problems that are unseen to LLMs; testing over 30 models on more than 1,000 questions revealed a gap between familiar and unseen distributions that test-time scaling could help elicit.

items.title: RELexED: Retrieval-Enhanced Legal Summarization with Exemplar Diversity
items.title_zh: RELexED：基于示例多样性的检索增强法律摘要
items.summary: RELexED is a retrieval-augmented legal summarization framework that selects exemplar summaries using a determinantal point process to balance similarity and diversity, and outperforms baselines without exemplars or similarity-only selection on two datasets.
